csv_project_name: AE for Facilities & Parks Maintenance Shop Redevelopment
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Renton is seeking Statements of Qualifications SOQs from qualified Architectural and Engineering A&E firms to provide professional design and construction support services for a city-wide Facilities Master Planning and Parks Shop Redevelopment Project. The work will support facilities located at 1100 Bronson Way North and a newly acquired site at 2940 E Valley Rd, and will integrate long-term operational, planning, and construction needs across the City s maintenance functions. The selected Consultant will provide comprehensive professional services that may include project management and coordination, site evaluation and existing conditions assessment, demolition planning and support services, temporary facility planning, design and perrnaitting support to maintain ongoing operations during construction, architectural and engtneering design services, preparation of design and construction bid documents, construction administration, construction management, and coordination with City staff, stakeholders, and the public as required.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: A/E Services for Facilities and Parks Maintenance Shop Redevelopment
short_description: Design and master planning services for redevelopment of Renton maintenance and parks facilities.
project_location: Renton, Washington, USA; 1100 Bronson Way North and 2940 E Valley Rd
project_scope: City-wide facilities master planning and redevelopment project for maintenance functions, covering existing facilities at 1100 Bronson Way North and a newly acquired site at 2940 E Valley Rd. Scope includes site evaluation, existing conditions assessment, demolition planning, temporary facility planning to maintain operations during construction, redevelopment planning, design, permitting, bid documents, and construction-phase support for facilities and parks maintenance shop uses. No gross floor area, structural spans, or detailed technical building parameters are stated.
services: Architectural and engineering services; facilities master planning; parks shop redevelopment; project management and coordination; site evaluation; existing conditions assessment; demolition planning; temporary facility planning; permitting support; architectural design; engineering design; preparation of design and construction bid documents; construction administration; construction management; stakeholder and public coordination. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a general building and facilities maintenance redevelopment project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Scope is broad A/E and master planning oriented, with significant architectural, MEP, and project management components.
- Some potential relevance through civil engineering and redevelopment planning, but no indication of architecturally demanding or structurally innovative elements.
- No stated large spans, complex structural systems, sustainability innovation, or special materials.
- Maintenance shop and municipal operations facilities are generally lower priority for sbp unless notable structural complexity is present, which is not indicated here.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Useful cost-related information available: redevelopment of city maintenance and parks shop facilities at two sites, including demolition, temporary facilities, design, permitting, and construction support. A realistic estimate is not possible from the provided text alone because no building size, program area, phasing extent, or construction budget is given.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The procurement is for broad A/E consultant services including planning, design, bid documents, and construction support, but there is insufficient information to derive a reliable structural engineering fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from qualified architectural and engineering firms. No specific minimum reference projects, number of references, or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
